title: Tighten pre-launch QA issues across compliance copy, accessibility, SEO, and branding assets
body:
This PR addresses the pre-launch QA pass for the Medicare in Spokane site ahead of beta domain mapping. It focuses on content/compliance consistency, accessibility gaps, metadata cleanup, and a small branding asset optimization without changing site structure or redesigning pages.

- **Compliance and content cleanup**
  - Replaced disallowed marketing language outside the required CMS disclaimer (`unbiased`, `official Medicare`, `every plan`) with compliant alternatives.
  - Updated FAQ and comparison copy to emphasize comparing represented plans rather than implying full-market coverage.
  - Preserved the required CMS disclaimer text unchanged.

- **Accessibility fixes**
  - Corrected heading hierarchy in lead forms by promoting the embedded form heading to a section-level heading.
  - Fixed accessible-name mismatches on call/email/request CTAs so visible labels and ARIA labels align.
  - Increased testimonial carousel dot hit areas to meet mobile target-size expectations.
  - Improved footer text contrast on the dark background.
  - Increased team card CTA tap targets for mobile usability.

- **SEO and metadata cleanup**
  - Removed duplicated page-title suffixes on affected pages by normalizing route-level metadata.
  - Kept per-page titles/descriptions unique and consistent with the site-wide metadata template.
  - Left sitemap/robots behavior intact while confirming coverage/indexing behavior.

- **Branding and asset hygiene**
  - Confirmed header/footer use the approved logo assets (`logo-horizontal.png`, `hio-icon.png`).
  - Optimized the oversized footer icon asset to reduce payload without changing branding usage.

Example of the metadata cleanup pattern:

```ts
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Prescription Drug Plan Review Spokane",
  openGraph: {
    title: "Prescription Drug Plan Review Spokane",
  },
};
```
